CORN Strategies Snapshot

Friday October 16, 7:57 PM GMT

TREND: The trend in most active corn futures is higher for now, but is close to being revised to sideways.

NONCOMMERCIAL OUTLOOK: Noncommercial corn traders held a net-long futures position of 358,367 contracts as of Oct. 13, net-sellers of 94,106 contracts after the bearish October WASDE added over 400 mb to new-crop U.S. corn supplies compared to the September report.

COMMERCIAL OUTLOOK: Commercial corn traders held a net-short position of 326,958 contracts as of Oct. 13, and were net-buyers of 83,994 contracts through the CFTC reporting period. The December 2026 contract is priced 12 1/4 cents lower than the March 2027 contract, firming (less carry) 2 1/4 cents through the week and to the narrowest weekly close for the...

About DTN

DTN delivers accurate, objective, real-time, and actionable insights to increase our 2 million customers’ confidence and support their business decisions. In a data-rich world, our actionable insights in weather and financial analytics make sense of the information, drive change in processes and help businesses prosper. They empower our agriculture, energy and transportation customers – those who work endlessly to feed, fuel and protect our world. We believe that when our customers are supported with the most reliable and innovative information to the Nth Degree, they prosper and we all win. DTN is based in Minneapolis with offices globally.
